dogecoin.text:
The funny thing about #dogecoin is is that money becomes money when enough people collectively decide that it’s money. It’s true of dollars, gold, and #Bitcoin. 

Lots of enthusiasm + several million active wallets could be enough to drive serious retail adoption...

$AMP price action continues to show real strength. The semi-ironic adoption of #dogecoin demonstrates the flexibility & utility of the flexa network. I’m happy to get @mcuban on board.
